scripts.clean-build: npm run clean-shared && npm run clean-backend
scripts.build: npm run clean-build && npm run build --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.package: npm ci && npm run build && npm run clean-modules && npm ci && npm run copy-builds
scripts.copy-builds: rm -rf dist && cp -r backend/dist ./dist && cp -r backend/node_modules ./dist/node_modules && rm -rf dist/node_modules/@mau-arkiv/shared && mkdir -p dist/node_modules/@mau-arkiv/shared && cp shared/package.json dist/node_modules/@mau-arkiv/shared/package.json && cp -r shared/dist dist/node_modules/@mau-arkiv/shared/dist && cp -r backend/config ./dist/
